column1: # RULES.

# H2 Martin Luther King Jr. Day: the third Monday of January. NYSE closed; Globex equity abbreviated session
# H3 Washington's Birthday (Presidents' Day): the third Monday of February. NYSE closed; Globex equity abbreviated
#     session
# H4 Good Friday: Easter Sunday less two days (the anonymous Gregorian computus)
#     is scheduled that day. Globex equity-index futures closed: no session for the date.
